title: TrueNorth palette
description: The colour allow-list and the three-tone derivation rule, `assets/style/palette.json`. A build-time input like assets/credits.json (ADR-0004): read by the asset pipeline and by make verify-art, never by anything under app/, which is why it lives under assets/ rather than content/ and has no port type. What this schema pins is the machine-readable half - the colour table, the ramps, the ink assignment, the level theme - so the generator that derives 26 of the 31 ramps from the published formula cannot silently change the file's shape. What it deliberately does not pin is the prose half: `shading`, `outline`, `ambientOcclusion` and `restrictedMarks` are rules written for a person and for the art checker, and a JSON Schema that enumerated their fields would be a second, weaker copy of a document the art agent owns. Those four are required to be objects and are otherwise unconstrained here, which is stated rather than left to be discovered.

licence.description: The palette is original work and ships under the project's asset licence (ADR-0004).

shading.description: The three-tone derivation rule, the key light, the formula and its family overrides. Prose and numbers for the art checker; not enumerated here (see this file's description).

outline.description: Stroke weights and where outlines apply. Not enumerated here.

ambientOcclusion.description: Baked AO rules. Not enumerated here.

colours.description: The allow-list: every fill and stroke any SVG may use, keyed by id. The palette lint fails on a colour that is not here.

ramps.description: Three-tone ramps, keyed by material. Every tone names a key in `colours`; validate-content cross-checks that once this file is in its input set.

inks.description: Outline colour ids to the rule for choosing between them.

levelTheme.description: Palette ids proposed per level for the sky/ground/horizon gradient. A proposal: the level document owns its own theme block (ADR-0002, level.schema.json).

restrictedMarks.description: Marks that must never be drawn, and why. A legal constraint recorded as data so verify-art can quote it. Not enumerated here.

designResolution.title: Design resolution
designResolution.description: Portrait, 1080x1920 (ADR-0002). Named width and height rather than the shared vec2: this is a canvas size, not a point, and it reads better in the file it lives in.

paletteRamp.title: Palette ramp
paletteRamp.description: One material's three flat fills. `derived` records whether the light and shade tones came from the published formula or were authored by hand; the four atmosphere ramps the formula does not govern are the only false values, and the art checker re-derives every true one.

family.description: Which family override the formula applied, when one did (skin, hair).

material.description: What this ramp is the colour of, in words. Nepean sandstone, oxidised copper, canal ice.
